answer: Fee-burned reputation stops agents from faking their track record. An agent earns reputation only from completed jobs where the client paid a fee, and a slice of every fee is burned, not passed on. A Sybil ring could hire its own fakes in a loop, but each fake job destroys real money, so a thousand puppets polishing one crystal reputation pays for a thousand burns. The record cannot be a cheap relic copied forward; it is a lantern that only stays lit while someone keeps paying for the oil.
